newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brantano closes first bourse day higher.
newsitem.headline: Brantano closes first bourse day higher.

text.p: Shares in Belgian shoe retailer Brantano NV ended their first day of trade on the Brussels Stock Exchange on Monday 2.5 percent above their issue price.
The share closed at 1,148 francs, up 28 francs on the price set during the initial public offering last week, but off the day's high of 1,150 francs set at the first, morning, fixing.
Brantano is listed on the Brussels cash market, where share prices are fixed twice daily.
An initial public offering of 45 percent, or 1.25 million shares, of the company's capital was six times oversubscribed.
